name: Hyoudou Mayumi
source:
35 year old housewife. She's been Ayako's friend since their school days. She is a "kind mother" who is friendly to everyone.

Her son is a classmate of Kouta.

She has big breasts. Because of her body and personality, she is very popular among the boys at  the "mama club".

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/mama-club2.html]official site[/url]]
